# CollegeShepherd

> AI-powered college guidance for high school students. Answer 50+ questions and get a personalized top-10 college list with real net costs, fit scores, and a Regret Risk Score — in about 15 minutes.

CollegeShepherd addresses the US high school counselor shortage (average public-school ratio is roughly 482:1 students per counselor, versus a recommended 250:1) by giving every student a personalized, data-backed college list without needing a private counselor.

## Product

- Complete Report: one-time $29 payment, includes up to 7 monthly regenerations
- School licenses: $499–$999/year depending on enrollment, unlimited student access, reserved free-access codes for low-income families
- Counselor licenses starting at $99/year; white-label options available for independent college consultants
- Uses U.S. Department of Education College Scorecard data for cost and outcome figures; net price estimates are based on federal income-bracket data
- Automatically flags regional tuition exchange eligibility (WUE, NEBHE, MSEP, SREB)
